User.title: User
User.description: Pilgrim, Vendor, or Admin account profile document in Firestore users/{uid}

name.description: Full name of the user or contact person

phone.description: Mobile phone number with country code

email.description: Email address for auth and communication

elderlyOrDisabledMode.description: Whether wheelchair and senior accessibility mode is enabled

shopName.description: Name of the registered vendor shop/stall

licenseOrGstin.description: FSSAI license or GSTIN registration number

category.description: Shop category e.g. Food, Puja Samagri, Accommodation, Medical

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp of account creation

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp of last update

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles with role-based routing (pilgrim, vendor with approval status, admin)
